headline: Day 21 usage reset has landed
scope: Day 21 usage reset verified on the site owner’s account.

announcement.text: Day 21/ Wonder what happens the remaining seven days. But today is a reset.
announcement.translation: 第 21 天：不知道剩下七天会发生什么。不过今天是重置日。

note: The site owner confirmed restored usage on their own account. The recorded time is the site observation record time, not the exact reset time. Tibo’s post says today is a reset, without specifying an execution time, eligible plans or usage windows; no separate completion confirmation was found in this read.
